items.Sentence: Treatment components include influent flow monitoring, bar screens, barminutors, an aerated grit tank...
Treatment components include... primary settling basins...
Treatment components include... four secondary aeration basins, and secondary clarifiers.
Secondary treated wastewater is chlorinated and dechlorinated and is either diverted to tertiary treatment or is metered prior to discharge.
Waste activated sludge is thickened by dissolved air floatation and blended with primary solids before anaerobic digestion.
Digested sludge is dewatered by belt filter press and hauled offsite for disposal at the Monterey Regional Waste Management District Landfill.

Treated secondary effluent is filtered using a submerged microfiltration system which produces filtrate under vacuum conditions by a filtration pump. The system contains three cells with a total filtrate capacity of 1.9 MGD. The microfiltration system serves as a pretreatment to reverse osmosis; a portion of the microfiltration flow is not treated by reverse osmosis but instead blended with reverse osmosis permeate.
Reverse osmosis reject water is chlorinated and dechlorinated before it is sent to the effluent station for ocean discharge.
